entries.title: Genesis, the founder's draft
entries.preamble: The first proposal. Frozen and unsignable. Every later version builds on this one or starts its own line. Genesis v1.0, as it will be entered on the real ledger.

goals.title: The Longest Healthy Lives on Earth
goals.wording: People here live more years in good health, in body and mind, than anywhere on Earth, and chronic disease is the exception at every age.

goals.title: A Secure Home, and One You Can Own
goals.wording: Everyone who lives here has a secure home they can afford, and every Bermudian who wants to own a home can.

goals.title: The 15-Minute Island
goals.wording: Anyone can get to what they need, and anything can get to them, within fifteen minutes, at any hour, without owning a vehicle.

goals.title: Private People, Open Institutions
goals.wording: Your identity and data are yours: every use is logged and you can read the log. Every public body is open about how it decides.

goals.title: More Nature Than We Inherited
goals.wording: Reef, shoreline and native forest are healthier every decade, the ocean still feeds us, and we hand on more nature than we were given.

goals.title: Power and Water You Never Worry About
goals.wording: Power and water are clean, made here and affordable, and they do not fail, even after a hurricane.

goals.title: Safe at Every Hour
goals.wording: Everyone is safe and feels safe, anywhere on the island, at any hour.

goals.title: A Nation of Builders
goals.wording: Every child leaves school able to build a good life here, anyone can learn what they need next at any age, and trying an idea the world might value is cheap enough to be normal.

goals.title: A Good Life on an Ordinary Income
goals.wording: Work here pays for a good life, from the first job to a secure retirement.

goals.title: A Place Bermudians Choose
goals.wording: Bermudians choose Bermuda: to stay, to come home, and to stay connected wherever they live.

fairness_test.wording: A goal is met only when it is true for every walk of life, every race, every age and every parish.
